avis.titre: Good pads
avis.texte: I dont know long term how they're working but they're very cleansing and feel good going on. I love the texture it feels like it exfoliates, hope it does. Extremely moisturizing .I put them only after cleaning face, to get rest of any oil or makeup off, leave on 5 minutes -as per directions or longer. Only thing I dont like is they stick together, even with provided plastic teeezers. Also wiish they were less expensive.

avis.titre: Brighter, Smoother Skin in One Easy Step!Brighter, Smoother Skin in One Easy Step!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Snidin Toner Pads! They’ve quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The pads are super gentle but still do an amazing job of removing leftover dirt, oil, and makeup after cleansing. My skin always feels refreshed, smooth, and hydrated after using them. One of my favorite things about them is how versatile they are. Not only can you swipe them across your face like a normal toner pad, but you can also place a few of them on areas like your cheeks, forehead, or chin and leave them on for a few minutes like a mini face mask. It’s such an easy way to give your skin extra hydration and calming care when it needs it. They don’t irritate my skin at all, and I’ve noticed my complexion looking brighter and more even since I started using them. My face feels clean and refreshed without that tight, dry feeling. If you’re looking for something convenient, gentle, and multi-purpose for your skincare routine, I highly recommend these toner pad.

avis.titre: Give it a shot. Swear it’s good
avis.texte: Gave it a shot and I do see a difference in my face. Love it 😊

avis.titre: Bright skin
avis.texte: I love this fresh clean toner. I use it nightly and it keeps my skin bright

avis.titre: Definitely worth buying
avis.texte: So far so good! Love the way they feel as I’m using & the way my face feels afterwards. The smell is light. These are something I will be subscribing to especially for the price and amount you get in the package. Ingredients are nice and gentle for my sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Excellent
avis.texte: Excellent! These are very large and they make your skin feel really soft

avis.titre: Awesome
avis.texte: Good for cleaning my face at night, cleans all oil and make up off

avis.titre: WOW. I can see how these are a viral trend.
avis.texte: I am embarrassed to admit this, but I delayed trying these for bit because I thought they were snail mucin. Snidin seemed like a clever play for using Snail Mucin together as a name. I'm not sure what I thought the "id" stood for. I'm not opposed to snail mucin - I have been using a new cream containing it and didn't want to double do it, that's all. The good news is the toner pads were safely sealed and boxed and ready for me when I was ready for them. The box was sealed. The plastic tub was sealed. I liked that you could open it directly from inside of the lid and didn't have to twist off the entire body of the lid to pull it off. I also like the design of where the little tweezers rest. They are secure and do not fall inside every time you close the lid like most toner lids that put it across the very top. These were 100% worth the wait, even though I didn't need to wait to use them after all. I shared my story because it's a bit funny. Wonder if anyone else got confused like this. I have used several brands of toner pads, in fact have been finishing off a few of them lately. These are hands down the best I have ever used. The other brands have all been K-beauty and these are C-beauty. Just a comment, I typically use Korean skincare. I am a huge fan of Centella Asiatica in skincare, as it's one of the few things that is always effective and never irritates my skin. avis.titre: Good toner pads
avis.texte: I've used these toner pads twice a day for two weeks. I like that the pads are large and thick enough to use on my entire face and neck without them rolling or drying out. I like the little tweezers they provide to pick the individual pads out. But for the price, I did not notice any difference with my skin than the results I get from my other much cheaper toner. If you're looking for convenience or something for travel then you might find the price worth it, but I'll stick to my old toner that cost much less.

avis.titre: Soothing and softening
avis.texte: I don't use toners a lot, but I do have a couple I swear by. I prefer non-astringent toners that soothe and moisturize my skin instead of tightening pores and reducing oil. This one sounded perfect for my needs and it even has CICA, one of my favorite soothing skincare ingredients, as well as collagen. The toner pads come in a pop-open tub with a pair of plastic tweezers in the lid so that you don't need to stick your hands in the jar and are able to grab just one pad easily. These are nice sized pads (almost the size of the palm of my hand) and are very saturated in toner. They have a mild smell that I associate with CICA products, but nothing major. Each pad was more than enough to cover my whole face, neck, and décolletage, with product leftover. On application, they feel a little bit slimy (but only slightly) and very wet. The toner itself left my face with a very faint tackiness while it was wet, but there was no noticeable leftover stickiness once my skin had absorbed the product. I was honestly very pleasantly surprised. My skin was left feeling soothed, soft and plumped and looked great! I've been having some issues with flaking and some irritation around my nose from the cold winter weather and these not only felt soothing, but actually helped ease the redness and stinging. I'm glad I took a chance on these!

avis.titre: Gentle, Hydrating Toner Pads That Really Work for Winter
avis.texte: I ordered "Sniden Toner Pads" and I have really enjoyed using them. They feel much more gentle and hydrating than another toner pad I have used in the past, which always felt a bit harsh and sometimes even drying. These pads have no noticeable scent to me, which I appreciate, and they feel very soothing on my skin instead of irritating it. I also like that they include small tongs so you do not have to touch the pads with your fingers, which helps keep the rest of the product clean. They are made in China, but I was pleasantly surprised by how transparent the brand was about the ingredients. This is actually the first beauty product I have ordered that was made in China where the ingredients were clearly listed on the seller’s page. That alone felt like a refreshing change, since ingredients are often missing for beauty products, supplements, and even food, and I think that information is extremely important for buyers to have before deciding. Now that winter has set in where I live in the Midwest and the air is very cold and dry, these toner pads have been especially helpful. Other toner pads worked fine during warmer and more humid months, but once winter arrived they started drying my skin out. These solved that problem and keep my skin feeling hydrated and comfortable throughout the day. I have been using them twice a day with consistently good results, and they have quickly become my go-to toner pads for winter. As of December 2025, these are selling for around $37. For

avis.titre: Good ingredients. Hydrating, refreshing, soothing. Serum on pads absorbs well/no residue. Pricey.
avis.texte: These toner pads are infused with a serum composed of an impressive collection of ingredients that promote hydration, barrier repair, soothing, and brightening of the skin. The pads are thin, and are textured on one side. While each pad is coated in the serum, the pad is not drenched in serum like some other toner pads I have used. The instructions provide that you can use these as a regular toner, or apply them to specific areas for several minutes as more of a quick mask. I have used the pads both ways. My sensitive skin after use felt more hydrated, refreshed, and soothed, and it looked a bit brighter. The moisture from the pads absorbs quickly with no sticky residue left on the skin, which is something I appreciate. While the ingredients in the serum are good, they are not particularly unique. Based on my experience trying many toners, most higher quality toners contain the same ingredients as these pads. I point this out only because the current $38 sale price on these is, in my opinion, a little crazy considering this is not a well-established brand. Of the many toner pads I have tried, many of which I preferred to these pads, none was remotely close to these in price. The price is the reason I give these four stars rather than five. I would purchase them in the future but only if they were substantially discounted.

avis.titre: Great Toner Pads with Centella Asiatica Extract
avis.texte: The Snidin Centella Asiatica Toner Pads are good everyday toner pads to add to your skincare routine. The pads come in a snap lid container and includes little tweezer for removing the pads to use. I have been using these at daily after washing my face and using the rougher side to glide over my face. The instructions state you can use the soft side as more of a mask but I have not used it that way. Immediate after using my skin feels lighter and cleaner. Zero sickness and no adverse reactions. All I feel is smoothness! I even feel the difference of my skin when applying make up - it goes on so smoothly. These pads are a little on the pricy side but I if they work for your skin type I would say it’s worth it.

avis.titre: Very moisturizing and feel Refreshing
avis.texte: I have been using regular astringent toner in general from various brands but this items are truly great where it's very moisturizing and it comes with pads soaking with all the essence, instead of using additional cotton pad. The toner pad feels refreshing and gel likes feeling while being applied on, but doesn't feel slimy at all. In additional, I can use one pad for the whole face and even neck. It can be used like a partial facial mask by applying it on both cheek and forehead, but I think it's a bit wasteful. The price is a bit steep for 70 pads compared to many other brands, which is why I minus the 1 star. Otherwise, the toner pad suits well and give a good moisturizing effect to my dry skin.

avis.titre: Hydrating and Gentle Toner Pads for Daily Use
avis.texte: These toner pads are really nice for everyday skincare. They’re gentle, hydrating, and feel soothing on the skin, especially thanks to the centella asiatica. My skin feels refreshed and moisturized after using them, and they help with overall dullness and uneven tone over time. The pads are well-soaked without dripping, and they work well both as a quick swipe toner or as mini mask pads on areas that need extra hydration. The formula feels lightweight and non-irritating, making it suitable for all skin types. I’m giving it 4 stars because while they’re great for hydration and calming, the brightening results are more gradual rather than dramatic. Overall, a solid toner pad option that’s easy to incorporate into a daily routine.

avis.titre: Gentle scent, well moistened.
avis.texte: Toner pads 70 count: I find many pads are just so small - these are nice and large. One is plenty to do my entire face. All pads are nice and moist, not dried out. They have a gentle scent. You can even use them as a mask by applying to areas for 5-8 minutes. They go on smoothly. I did find them a little gooey but that doesn't last as you use the pad. Easy to use, no rinse required. My skin felt softer after. Did a good job removing anything my regular cleanser left behind.

avis.titre: Gentle Daily Toner Pads
avis.texte: I have been using these toner pads every morning after washing my face, and they feel very gentle and calming. The centella helps soothe my skin, especially on days when it feels a bit irritated. The pads are moist but not dripping, and one pad is enough for my whole face. I noticed my skin feels more hydrated and looks a little brighter over time. They are easy to use and fit well into my daily routine.

avis.titre: A bit jumbled up, but after sorting that out; I love em!
avis.texte: Besides being a bit messy and folded up inside; these toner pads are amazing! They are ultra-hydrating and cooling. I was especially delighted that there was no scent; and the pads themselves were soft; almost a similar texture to a sheet mask. Never have experienced toner pads like this before. They have quite a large surface area; making them ideal for spot treatment. I prefer using them in a sweeping motion rather than leaving them on though. The serum absorbs very quickly into my skin, and leaves me feeling comfortably dry (but hydrated) and ready for the rest of my routine. Not sticky!!!!

avis.titre: Not bad, but not seeing any good results from it either.
avis.texte: I’m actually shocked at how expensive these toner pads are. While I think they’re decent, they certainly aren’t anything remarkable. They come in a container with little tweezers, which makes it easier to grab one out. I like that the round pads are heavily saturated. They didn’t really have a scent that I noticed. I like that there’s one side that’s textured with bumps and one side that’s flat. I like using the textured side as I feel that gets into my skin better. This is not at all astringent like a lot of other toners I’ve used. It’s very light and refreshing. My skin soaks it up pretty quickly so while it is hydrating, I certainly wouldn’t classify it as deeply hydrating as my skin does not look glowy or dewy after using it. It does not help any of the redness on my face either. I definitely don’t think this is a bad product, but I’m honestly not really noticing anything different with it and certainly nothing worth the expensive price tag.

avis.titre: TikTok sensation, not bad in real life
avis.texte: Girl math time... This is good for 70 applications. The full price of it is $46.99, so it's $.67 per application. I found this toner to be pretty good, honestly. I wouldn't say it's my favorite, but I do like it. I like having toner in prepared pads because I can take it with me when I go to the gym and just do a quick skincare after my post-workout shower. But for the price of these, I'm not sure I think it's entirely worth it. My previous toner is about $.41 per use and seems to work just as well. If the pads were smaller, I might have taken off a star, but because they are large enough that I can also use them as a "mask", it makes them feel more worth it. Not for nothing, but I would have never thought to use them as a mask if it wasn't mentioned in the product page details! So now what I do is use the pad across my entire face and neck, then cut the pad in half and use it on my face as a mask. There is enough toner in each pad that it can cover my skin in the swipe, and still work well as a mask. Given that, the fact that it works well, and the ease of having it in a travel-friendly container, I've decided that not only do I recommend these, I'm also going to keep stock of them!

avis.titre: Exfoliating pads with collagen that hydrate; jury's still out on dark spot improvement
avis.texte: I purchased Snidin Toner Pads - with Centella Asiatica Extract and Collagen to help combat the dark spots that have unfortunately popped up on my skin over the years thanks to hyperpigmentation and sun exposure. I have tried nearly every product under the sun to lessen their appearance, from high end creams to prescription treatments and everything in between. I didn't really have high hopes for these pads as I have been disappointed by many such products in the past. These pads come with a handy set of plastic tweezers that fit conveniently in the top of the jar. Pulling out a single pad was easy, and the pad was moist but not sopping wet. It is textured on one side, which helps exfoliate the skin slightly. I rubbed all over my face, leaving behind the asiatica extract and collagen, which dried quickly and didn't leave my skin feeling taut. Whether or not it actually helps reduce dark spots remains to be seen, however. As with any such product, I think it would take months of continuous use before I would see any improvement, so I remain skeptical, but hopeful. I like the option to use a pad as a mask instead, which I think would deliver better treatment over the long run, so I will use that method going forward. I did not have any redness or irritation from using them, and my skin felt softer and smoother as well as being more hydrated afterward. That being said, for the price point, which is fairly high, I am not certain these pads are better/different than any other toner

avis.titre: Gentle Hydration, Moisturizing, Cleansing
avis.texte: This lovely packaged container of toner pads has a light scent, and provides gentle hydration, cleansing, and moisturization. I like them for everyday use, but they can be used as a mask when used as directed. The container closes and locks very nicely, and there is a pair of clear plastic tweezers that fit into pre-cut out areas and stay in place under the lid of the container. The toner pads are heavily saturated, ready for use, and the tweezers are helpful to grab a single pad out of the container without having to mess up or jumble the contents with your fingers. I find them great for home or travel use, and particularly helpful with targeting those specific, stubborn skin areas. Like having your very own personal spa experience at home. A+

avis.titre: Smoother skin
avis.texte: I chose this snidin product because I saw it was viral on TikTok. I thought it would be fun to try! I'm actually really happy with the results. My skin feels smoother. I have experienced zero irritation from this, and my skin is somewhat sensitive so this is worth noting. It's a pleasant feeling to slide these toner pads over your face. I have noticed my pores appear smaller as well. There were two safety seals which always makes me feel more confident using a product. There are also cute little tweezers built into the tub. This is great so you're not contaminating the rest of the contents, and it just feels like a nice touch. These are an enjoyable part of my skincare routine. I'm very pleased with how well these are working for my skin. Good quality, and worth trying. Would recommend, these are exceeding my expectations.

avis.titre: Convenient Toner Pads, but Expensive for What You Get
avis.texte: These are pre-soaked toner pads, and they do exactly what they’re supposed to do. The pads are well saturated and easy to use, making them convenient if you like a quick, no-mess toner step. My skin felt hydrated after using them, and I didn’t notice any irritation. That said, there isn’t anything here that feels dramatically different from using a regular liquid toner. For me, this felt more like a convenience product than a necessity. You’re essentially paying a premium for the pads themselves, since you could get similar results from a bottled toner applied with your hands or a spray. The formula itself seems fine and gentle, and the pads are soft and usable for face or spot treatment. However, at this price point, it’s hard to justify compared to traditional toners that last longer and cost significantly less. Overall, these are convenient, but the value may not make sense unless you strongly prefer toner pads over liquid formulas.

avis.titre: Gentle toner pads with a moist and soothing feel
avis.texte: These toner pads are generously soaked without dripping, and they glide smoothly across my skin without pulling or causing irritation. The cotton texture is soft and even, which makes them comfortable for me to use on both my face and neck. The liquid has a light, watery consistency with a clean finish. After application, my skin feels hydrated and balanced rather than sticky or heavy. I find the pads stay consistently saturated from the top to the bottom of the jar. The container seals well, and the included tweezers make it easy for me to keep everything clean during use.
